content.text: Corinne SullivanFri, April 10, 2026 at 4:05 PM UTC0Meet the Full ‘Temptation Island’ Season 2 CastNetflixGet excited, friends, because Temptation Island season 2 is here!! This new season (which is technically the show’s tenth overall but second on Netflix) follows four struggling couples as they’re separated and tempted to stray by a fleet of sexy singles, and let me tell ya, it is dramatic. Once again, Mark L. Walberg returns as host/unofficial couples therapist to help out the four new couples: Kaylee and Summit, Sydney and Mikey, Scarlett and Cole, and Shyanne and Jack. But will these pairs resist the 24 tempters and temptresses they encounter on the island? You’ll have to watch to find out!Scroll on to meet the full cast for Netflix’s Temptation Island season 2 and find out where to follow them on Instagram (you’re welcome).
